lines.zh: 巨龟四鳍划着沙地前进
lines.en: The giant turtle rows itself over the sand.
Its shell drags a shallow trench.
Each step is followed by a pause.

lines.zh: 它爬过沙滩，留下宽宽的痕
lines.en: A broad track marks the beach behind it.
A wave shoves it; it holds steady.

lines.zh: 它的脖子慢慢前后伸缩
lines.en: Its neck telescopes slowly in and out.

lines.zh: 它沿着水线一路向上爬
lines.en: It climbs along the tide line.

lines.zh: 前鳍插进沙里再拔出来
lines.en: Front flippers dig in and pull free.

lines.zh: 它绕过一块礁石，很费劲
lines.en: Rounding a rock costs it real effort.
Seaweed clings to its shell.
It inches its way up the slope.
Its shadow slides slowly over the sand.
It stops, as if catching its breath.

lines.zh: 沙粒从甲缘一颗颗滚落
lines.en: Grains roll off the rim of its shell.

lines.zh: 它朝着水声的方向挪动
lines.en: It drags itself toward the sound of water.

lines.zh: 四鳍一撑，它越过了浅坑
lines.en: Four flippers push it over a dip.
The giant turtle pulls its head in.

lines.zh: 只剩一个圆壳晒在太阳下
lines.en: Only a round shell sits in the sun.
Its head creeps back out.
Its small eye blinks twice.
The shell is warm from the sun.
It holds still, posing as a rock.
A seabird lands on its shell.
It scoops sand beneath itself.

lines.zh: 一条腿无意识地划着沙
lines.en: One flipper scrapes the sand idly.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸慢得几乎听不见
lines.en: Its breathing is nearly silent.

lines.zh: 壳缝里钻出一株小海草
lines.en: A sprig of weed sprouts from a seam.

lines.zh: 它侧头看了看翻涌的浪
lines.en: It tilts its head at the breaking surf.
The giant turtle eyes you from its shell.
It stretches its neck a little closer.
It sniffs at your boots.
It decides you are no threat.
It tips its head to one side.
I watch you from under my shell rim.

lines.zh: 它挪了挪，让你看清甲壳
lines.en: It shifts so you can see its shell.
The plates on its shell read like tree rings.
It neither retreats nor approaches.

lines.zh: 它看你一会儿，又低头扒沙
lines.en: After a look, it goes back to digging.

lines.zh: 巨龟吃痛，立刻缩进壳里
lines.en: Hurt, it pulls straight into its shell.
It draws all four flippers in tight.
A crack appears on its shell.
It scrambles frantically for the water.
It makes a very small sound.
It stays shut in for a long while.

lines.zh: 沙子被它拍得到处都是
lines.en: Sand sprays from its flippers.
It pokes its head out to inspect the spot.
I pull my head in until only shell shows.
It creeps away, trying to hide.
The giant turtle smells seaweed.
Its head slides out of the shell.
It takes a bite and chews slowly.

lines.zh: 它朝着你的手挪了一步
lines.en: It shuffles one step toward your hand.

lines.zh: 它伸长脖子够最后一片
lines.en: Its neck stretches for the last piece.
Done, it retreats into its shell.
It drags the food to the water's edge.

lines.zh: 它吃完还盯着你的口袋
lines.en: Finished, it stares at your pocket.

lines.zh: 它高兴时脖子会上下点
lines.en: When pleased, its neck bobs up and down.
Its mouth opens wide, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你撞上巨龟的壳，硬得吓人
lines.en: You hit its shell, shockingly hard.

lines.zh: 它被撞得偏了一点方向
lines.en: The bump shifts it slightly off line.

lines.zh: 它把头和鳍全缩了进去
lines.en: Head and flippers vanish inside.
It simply waits for you to move on.
A front flipper clips your foot.

lines.zh: 它慢慢挪开，让出一条路
lines.en: It slowly shifts aside to let you pass.
When it bumps you, you barely feel it.
Its shell rim scrapes your calf.
It flinches in, then back out.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子压在身下
lines.en: It settles over your shadow.

lines.zh: 两只巨龟在沙滩上并排
lines.en: Two giant turtles lie abreast on the sand.

lines.zh: 它们的头互相轻碰一下
lines.en: Their heads touch lightly.

lines.zh: 一只替另一只清理甲缝
lines.en: One clears the seams of the other's shell.

lines.zh: 它们用鳍扒开同一片沙
lines.en: They dig the same patch of sand.

lines.zh: 它们挪动得很慢，很一致
lines.en: They shift slowly, in unison.

lines.zh: 两只壳在阳光下一样发亮
lines.en: Both shells gleam alike in the sun.

lines.zh: 它们把坑挖得更深了些
lines.en: They deepen the nest together.

lines.zh: 一头守着，另一头去取食
lines.en: One keeps watch while the other feeds.

lines.zh: 它们靠在一起，像两块石头
lines.en: They rest together like two boulders.

lines.zh: 海浪打上来，它们都没动
lines.en: The surf comes in; neither moves.
It grips the seaweed and swallows slowly.

lines.zh: 它把食物按在沙上撕开
lines.en: It pins the food on the sand and tears it.
It carries the item toward the water.
It sniffs before deciding.
What it rejects, it shoves aside.
It lifts the thing carefully in its beak.
It tucks the food under its shell.
Afterward it licks the corner of its mouth.
It buries what is left in the sand.
When it drops, it stoops to reach.

lines.zh: 巨龟忽然把头缩了回去
lines.en: The giant turtle snaps its head in.
It scrambles desperately for the water.
Four flippers fling sand everywhere.
Panicked, its direction goes wild.

lines.zh: 甲壳撞上石头，闷响一声
lines.en: Its shell strikes a rock with a thud.

lines.zh: 它伸头看你在哪，又缩回
lines.en: It peeks out at you, then retracts.
It flees at its best speed.
Its breathing turns ragged.
It presses itself flat to the ground.
The shell is its only defence.

lines.zh: 它一边逃一边撞翻海草
lines.en: Fleeing, it knocks the seaweed flat.
It wants only distance from you.
The giant turtle stays shut in its shell.
It curls up tight and holds still.
It watches you through the shell gap.
It edges behind a rock.
It tries to reach the waterline.

lines.zh: 壳在你脚边，像块大石头
lines.en: The shell sits by your feet like a boulder.
It will move only once you leave.
Its head retreats even deeper.

lines.zh: 它一点一点朝浪声移动
lines.en: It inches toward the sound of surf.

lines.zh: 它逃得很慢，却从不回头
lines.en: It flees slowly and never looks back.

lines.zh: 沙子从它鳍下簌簌流出
lines.en: Sand hisses out from under its flippers.
It hides among the ripples of the shallows.

lines.zh: 巨龟猛地一缩，把你撞开
lines.en: It snaps shut and knocks you back.
A flipper slaps your leg.
Its shell rim jabs your knee.
Turning, it bowls you over.
Its neck darts out for a bite.
Having bitten, it retracts at once.

lines.zh: 它拍起的沙子迷了你的眼
lines.en: Its flailing sand gets in your eyes.

lines.zh: 它撞你的时候自己在发抖
lines.en: It trembles even as it strikes.

lines.zh: 这一下毫无章法，只是慌
lines.en: There is no skill in it, only panic.

lines.zh: 它把自己翻了过去，又挣回来
lines.en: It flips itself over and struggles back.

lines.zh: 沙滩上多了一个圆圆的影子
lines.en: A round shadow appears on the beach.
The tide shoves the turtle ashore.

lines.zh: 它从沙里拱起半个身子
lines.en: It heaves half its body out of the sand.
Water drips off its shell.
It shakes the sand off its head.
It climbs the beach and pauses.
Weed is still wound round its flipper.
It heads for higher ground.

lines.zh: 一个小沙堆被它顶开了
lines.en: A little dune is pushed open by it.
The tide withdraws and leaves it there.

lines.zh: 甲壳被烤得发烫，它连滚带爬
lines.en: The shell heats up; it scrambles away.

lines.zh: 落地时壳磕得很重，它缩没了头
lines.en: The shell cracks down hard; its head vanishes.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，它奋力抬头
lines.en: Water in its nostrils; it fights to lift its head.

lines.zh: 爆炸把它掀得翻了半圈
lines.en: The blast flips it half over.
An arrow wedges into a shell seam.

lines.zh: 魔法让它壳内的身体一阵抽动
lines.en: Magic sets its body twitching inside the shell.

lines.zh: 饿得久了，它连头都懒得伸
lines.en: Starving, it will not even extend its head.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着壳面爬，它抖个不停
lines.en: Lightning crawls the shell; it shakes all over.

lines.zh: 虚空拖它下沉，四鳍拼命拍打
lines.en: The void drags it down; flippers beat wildly.
